name: catalog-products-public-readback
objective: Close field central-catalog lookup/link/proposal/store-local price-stock operations and required public readback.
truthOwner: DSH central catalog owns product identity/taxonomy and operational assortment state; app-field only captures allowed store-local attributes.
journeys: field catalog setup to governed public readback

tasks.objective: Resolve barcode capture against current authority and close central-catalog lookup/link/proposal conflict behavior.
tasks.currentProblem: Current field UI supports text barcode search but no proven camera scanner, and new proposals send barcode null.
tasks.requiredChange: Determine the current approved barcode requirement; implement camera scan through canonical catalog APIs if required, otherwise retain explicit evidence of non-requirement. Close version/conflict and batch retry behavior either way.
tasks.targetState: Field users can identify/link/propose products through approved central-catalog mechanisms with no local product identity and predictable conflicts.
tasks.action: Inspect current Product Truth/UX contracts and catalog APIs before UI changes; fix shared catalog/controller first and add barcode/version/batch tests.
mustNotChange: No fabricated barcode requirement if current authority says otherwise.
acceptanceCriteria: Barcode requirement has explicit authoritative disposition and working behavior if required.
Stale version/conflict is actionable and cannot overwrite newer truth.
Batch retry cannot duplicate saved assortment items.
tasks.rollback: Revert UI integration while preserving central catalog/version constraints.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused field catalog interaction commit.

tasks.objective: Prove store-local price/stock/assortment and proposal outcomes converge to required partner/operator/client readers.
tasks.currentProblem: Field success does not prove partner/operator readback or client publication eligibility after refresh/restart.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace committed assortment/proposal state through read models and public catalog projection with publication gates.
tasks.targetState: Partner/operator see committed field catalog state and clients see only eligible published products/stores.
tasks.action: Add cross-surface readback tests using one store/product identity, including out-of-stock, conflict and unpublished cases.
mustNotChange: No client visibility before publication gates.
No partner/client mutation added merely for readback.
No local balance/financial logic in catalog.
acceptanceCriteria: Partner/operator read the committed store-local values after refresh.
Client hides unready/unpublished product/store state and shows eligible state after gates.
Restart does not change authoritative result.
tasks.rollback: Forward-fix projections; never bypass publication gates to make tests pass.
